opts: It was the Collector whom approved the plan.
It was the Collector which approved the plan.
It is the Collector who approve the plan.
It was the Collector who approved the plan.
questions.why: Cleft sentence: It was + person + who + verb. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “A medicine that prevents disease”
questions.why: Prophylactic means preventive. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: Hardly he had arrived when the phone rang.
Hardly had he arrived when the phone rang.
Hardly he arrived than the phone rang.
Hardly had arrived he when the phone rang.
questions.why: Hardly + had + subject … when. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2026.

questions.q: Identify the error: “He needs not go there today.”
questions.why: As a modal, 'need' takes no -s: 'He need not go' (or 'does not need to go'). GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “I have two pens; one is blue and ____ is black.”
questions.why: With two items, the remaining one is 'the other'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: “He used to live here, ____?”
questions.why: 'Used to' is past, so the tag uses 'did'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “magnanimous”:
questions.why: 'Magnanimous' means generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Had the ambulance arrived earlier, the child ____.”
questions.why: Inverted third conditional takes 'would have + past participle'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: “Let’s go for a walk, ____?”
questions.why: Sentences beginning with 'Let's' take the tag 'shall we?'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q:
Rearrange the sentences P, Q, R and S to form a meaningful paragraph:
P. Hence, regular hand washing with soap is advised.
Q. Many infections spread through unwashed hands.
R. Water alone cannot remove all the germs.
S. Soap, however, breaks down their outer layer.
questions.why: 'However' contrasts with water; 'Hence' gives the conclusion. GPSC-style practice item.
